requirements.title: Patient Portal
requirements.description: Provide a secure and user-friendly portal for patients to access their medical information, communicate with healthcare providers, and manage their care.

requirements.title: Revenue Cycle Management
requirements.description: Streamline billing, insurance claims, and payment processes to improve financial transactions and reduce errors.

requirements.title: Patient Data Protection and Management
requirements.description: Ensure the secure storage, transmission, and management of patient data, including demographics, medical history, and treatment plans.

requirements.title: Telehealth and Remote Care
requirements.description: Enable patients to access telehealth services, virtual consultations, and remote patient monitoring to improve care outcomes and patient satisfaction.

requirements.title: Clinical Decision Support
requirements.description: Provide healthcare providers with clinical decision support tools and resources to improve diagnosis, treatment, and patient outcomes.

requirements.title: Interoperability and Integration
requirements.description: Ensure seamless integration with other healthcare systems, services, and devices to facilitate data exchange and improve care coordination.

requirements.title: Patient Engagement and Education
requirements.description: Empower patients to take an active role in their care through education, engagement, and self-management tools and resources.

requirements.title: HIPAA Compliance and Security
requirements.description: Maintain HIPAA compliance and ensure the security and confidentiality of patient data through robust security measures and protocols.

requirements.title: Appointment Scheduling and Management
requirements.description: Provide patients with convenient and efficient appointment scheduling and management capabilities to reduce wait times and improve satisfaction.

requirements.title: Prescription Management and Refills
requirements.description: Enable patients to view, manage, and refill their prescriptions electronically to improve medication adherence and reduce errors.

requirements.title: Lab Results and Medical Imaging
requirements.description: Provide patients with secure and convenient access to their lab results and medical imaging to improve patient engagement and care outcomes.

requirements.title: Emergency Symptom Detection and Response
requirements.description: Detect emergency symptoms and trigger immediate alerts and responses to ensure patient safety and timely interventions.

requirements.title: Virtual Triage and Symptom Checking
requirements.description: Provide patients with virtual triage and symptom checking capabilities to guide them to the appropriate level of care and improve patient outcomes.

requirements.title: Remote Patient Monitoring and Chronic Care Management
requirements.description: Enable remote patient monitoring and chronic care management to improve patient outcomes, reduce readmissions, and enhance patient satisfaction.

requirements.title: Patient Onboarding and Registration
requirements.description: Streamline patient onboarding and registration processes to improve patient satisfaction and reduce administrative burdens.

requirements.title: Insurance Claim and Billing Management
requirements.description: Automate and streamline insurance claim and billing processes to reduce errors, improve efficiency, and enhance patient satisfaction.
